functions.name: PerformLazyInitialization
functions.docs: Initialize the manager from the callback set by InitializeFromLazyCallback. It is expected that this callback calls one of the InitializeFromX functions.

functions.name: InitializeFromLazyCallback
functions.docs:
Initialize the manager lazily using the given callback. It is expected that this callback calls one of the InitializeFromX functions.
@param InLazyInitFunc	The function to call to initialize the manager.

functions.name: InitializeFromCache
functions.docs:
Initialize the manager using the given cache. This will perform an initial scan for localized packages.
@param InCache	The cache the manager should use.

functions.name: InitializeFromDefaultCache
functions.docs: Initialize this manager using the default cache. This will perform an initial scan for localized packages.

functions.name: InvalidateRootSourcePath
functions.docs:
Invalidate any cached state for the given root source path, and add it to the queue of things to process when ConditionalUpdateCache is called.
eg) when new asset registry state is loaded for a plugin that may invalidate its cached data

functions.name: ConditionalUpdateCache
functions.docs: Update this cache, but only if it is dirty.
